entities.summary: Saint James` church is a late Gothic three-nave hall church situated in James' square in the centre of Brno, in Czech Republic. One of the largest well-preserved Gothic churches in the Czech Republic. Its history starts in the beginning of the 13th century. The church was categorized as a national monument in 1995.
